title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 78 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 78 - General Tax Rebate in case of Certain Investments and Expenditure Subject to the provisions of this Act and subject to the limits, conditions and qualifications set out in Part 3 of the Sixth Schedule any investment made shall be entitle tax rebate on the total income of a resident natural person taxpayer and a non-resident Bangladeshi natural person in any tax year, as follows: (a) 0.03 x “A” ; or (b) 0.15 x “B” ; or (c) Tk. 10 (ten) lakhs, Whichever of these three is less, In this case— “A” = total income calculated excluding tax exempted income, such income subject to reduced rate of tax and such income subject to minimum tax, and “B” = Total investment and expenditure of the taxpayer as per Part 3 of the Sixth Schedule in any income year.
